findings.title: InteriorPoint() reports .optimal on an infeasible LP and discards crossover's own .infeasible verdict
findings.claim: README §2.5 InteriorPoint: 'Answers `.infeasibleOrUnbounded` when it cannot tell the two apart'; README §4 Limits/Results: 'Optimal' means 'feasible and dual feasible to 1e-7'; Tolerances.primalFeasibility = 1e-7.
findings.observed: Infeasible 3x4 LP: min x0+x1+x2+x3; r0: x0+x1 >= big; r1: x2+x3 >= 1; r2: x2+2x3 <= 1-delta; x >= 0 (Farkas y1=+1, y2=-1 gives A^T y = (0,0,0,-1) <= 0 and y^T b = delta > 0). big=1e6, delta=1e-3: all four IPM configurations, including the default InteriorPoint(), return .optimal obj=1000001.0030269028 after 8 iterations with reported primal residual 1.945e-9; an independent KKT check finds a row violation of 1.905e-3; crossover-lite itself ended .infeasible and only a warning remains. big=1e6, delta=1e-5: violation 1.24e-3; big=1e9: violation 0.23; big=1e3, delta=1e-5: violation 6.6e-6. Simplex(.dual) and Simplex(.primal) answer .infeasible in 2 iterations in every case.
findings.whyWrong: A provably infeasible model gets a success status and a point violating a row by up to 0.23, four to six orders of magnitude above the 1e-7 feasibility claim; the crossover proved infeasibility and its verdict was discarded.
findings.location: Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/IPMWorker.swift:657,696 (primal residual divided by 1+max|b| over all rows, so a 1e-3 violation on a row with rhs 1 counts as ~1e-9 next to a row with rhs 1e6); Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/InteriorPoint.swift:208-217 (a non-optimal crossover status becomes a warning and the interior point is returned as .optimal)

findings.title: InteriorPoint(crossover: .none) reports .optimal with a grossly wrong objective (up to ~290x) when finite variable bounds are large
findings.claim: README §2.5 offers crossover .none as a supported mode whose failure on hard problems is documented as .numericalFailure (README §4 defect 10); README §4 Results: 'Optimal' means feasible and dual feasible to 1e-7; Tolerances.ipmResidual 1e-8, 'Relative primal, dual and gap residuals'.
findings.observed: min x+y s.t. x+2y >= 1, 2x+y >= 1, -B <= x,y <= B (optimum 2/3): .optimal with objective 0.6666857 (B=1e4), 0.66857 (1e6), 0.8575 (1e8), 2.5745 (1e9), 19.745 (1e10), 191.45 (1e11), each in 7 iterations with reported primal residual 2.3e-9 and finalMu up to 48.6. Planted family (20 seeds, m=20, n=30, nonbinding bounds +-B): B=1e8 1/20 wrong (-3.898 vs -6.237, row violation 0.37), B=1e9 16/20 wrong (16.37 vs 2.53), B=1e10 20/20 wrong (47.95 vs 2.53), B=1e11 20/20 wrong (209.7 vs 2.28, row violation up to 43.5). findings.title: The 1e-4 stall ceiling makes the default InteriorPoint() answer .infeasibleOrUnbounded for feasible bounded badly scaled LPs instead of letting the simplex finish
findings.claim: README §2.5: 'When its residuals stall close to a solution, an ill-conditioned problem, the simplex finishes from the last iterate (`crossover: .lite`)'; README §4 defect 10: 'The default, with crossover, is not affected.'
findings.observed: Planted feasible bounded LPs with row/column scales 10^+-3 (m=30, n=50, seeds 3000-3099): InteriorPoint() .infeasibleOrUnbounded 1/100 (seed 3050) and InteriorPoint(presolve: false) 3/100 (seeds 3023, 3043, 3069), each with mu < 1e-10, dual residual <= 6e-14 and primal residual 1.17e-4 to 2.28e-4; simplex 200/200 optimal. Seed 3050: presolve on gives .infeasibleOrUnbounded at it=46 with primal residual 1.319e-4; presolve off stalls at 7.19e-5 and the simplex finishes at the known optimum 785976.99035; scaling .none stalls, then optimal.
findings.whyWrong: The iterate is at the optimum up to the primal residual (mu 5e-11, dual residual 6e-15); a residual of 1.3e-4 instead of < 1e-4 turns the documented simplex finish into a claim that the model is infeasible or unbounded.
findings.location: Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/IPMWorker.swift:720-741 and :866 (stallCeiling 1e-4: worst > stallCeiling gives .infeasibleOrUnbounded); Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/InteriorPoint.swift:146-147 (returned without trying the simplex)

findings.title: Presolve basis expansion returns a non-optimal basis (a basic column with nonzero reduced cost) after a singleton row
findings.claim: The basis of an .optimal result (InteriorPointAnalysis.finalBasis, SimplexAnalysis.basis) is an optimal basis for the returned point: README §2.5 crossover 'to a vertex'; it is what warm starts and the conditioning analyzer and Conditioned (README §2.6) use.
findings.observed: min -x0+x1+2x2; r0: -x0 <= 1 (singleton); r1: x0+x1+x2 >= 1; r2: x1-x2 <= 0.5; x0 <= -1; x1,x2 >= 0. InteriorPoint(), Simplex(.dual) and Simplex(.primal) with presolve on: optimal, obj 3.75, x = (-1, 1.25, 0.75), but status [basic, basic, basic, atUpper, atLower, atUpper] with reduced costs [-2.5, 0, 0, 0, 1.5, -0.5]: x0 basic with reduced cost -2.5; independent basis check dual infeasibility 0.833; a warm start of Simplex(presolve: false) from it needs 1 pivot (0 from the presolve-off basis); the analyzer's condition estimate is 4 instead of 2. findings.title: InteriorPoint() returns .feasible(stoppedBy: .timeLimit) when the time limit fires in the simplex that finishes a stall
findings.claim: README §2.5 InteriorPoint: 'It never returns `.feasible`: a limit or a cancellation gives `.noSolution`.'
findings.observed: Spread-3 planted LP 300x500 that stalls (seeds 3 and 4): time limits of 0.026-0.047 s give status .feasible(timeLimit) with crossover .feasible(timeLimit) after 115-451 pivots; for example a limit of 0.028 s gives objective 82474.26 against the optimum 82472.74, a feasible point (violation 3.8e-13) and bound nil. Reproduced in two runs; the window depends on timing.
findings.whyWrong: A status the documented contract excludes; code written to the documented status set of InteriorPoint does not expect it.
findings.location: Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/InteriorPoint.swift:163-171 (the stall path returns finished.base whatever its status)

findings.title: README defect 7 understates how often the interior point leaves infeasible versus unbounded undecided: on its own it never decides
findings.claim: README §4 defect 7: 'it answers `.infeasibleOrUnbounded` for some models; a simplex solve of the same model decides it'; README §2.5: 'when it cannot tell the two apart'.
findings.observed: 100/100 infeasible models (Farkas margin 0.5) and 100/100 unbounded models (planted ray), m=20 n=30: all four IPM configurations answer .infeasibleOrUnbounded every time; also 60/60 at Farkas margins 1e-3, 1e-6 and 1e-9. It returns .infeasible or .unbounded only when presolve decides or a stall below 1e-4 hands the model to the simplex. Simplex(.dual) and Simplex(.primal): exact status 100% with valid Farkas rays (own checker).
findings.whyWrong: 'Some models' describes the normal case: the IPM outcome has no infeasible or unbounded verdict at all, so every infeasible or unbounded model that presolve does not decide comes back undecided.
findings.location: Sources/ZTronLPInteriorPoint/IPMWorker.swift:712-719 (divergence to .infeasibleOrUnbounded is the only terminal verdict); README.md:449-451

summary: Seven reproduced findings. B3-01 (critical): the default InteriorPoint() returns .optimal on a provably infeasible LP whose row right-hand sides differ in magnitude (row violation up to 0.23), because the primal residual is divided by 1+max|b| and crossover's own .infeasible verdict is discarded. B3-02 (critical): InteriorPoint(crossover: .none) returns .optimal with objectives off by up to ~290x when finite bounds are 1e8-1e11, because residuals and gap are measured in the shifted standard form. B3-03 (high): feasible bounded LPs with |x*|, |y*| or finite bounds of about 1e12 or more get .infeasibleOrUnbounded at iteration 0 in every configuration (absolute 1e12 cap). B3-04 (medium): stalls whose residual lands just above 1e-4 make the default answer .infeasibleOrUnbounded on 1-3% of badly scaled feasible LPs, contradicting README defect 10 and §2.5. B3-05 (medium): presolve basis expansion returns non-optimal bases, for the simplex too. B3-06 (low): .feasible(timeLimit) despite README §2.5. B3-07 (low): defect 7 says 'some models', but the IPM never decides infeasible versus unbounded by itself. Held: KKT optimality on more than 1,200 planted LPs including degenerate and maximization ones, edge models, defect 10 on Hilbert, the README §5 Hilbert and netlib tables (iterations and pivots exact, relative error <= 1.33e-11), condition estimates within a factor of 2 of an explicit-inverse reference, the 16*m^2 memory cap, analyzer thresholds, the dense-column warning, Conditioned bit-identical to its engine, invariances, limits and cancellation.
